_about: Scout's notes (REVIEW-M5 R7). A note = optional firstLook line + the strength line for his best relevant attribute + the weakness line for his worst + sometimes a personality line. Groups and relevant attributes are in src/ui/screens/scoutNote.ts. Tokens: {foot} = left / right / either. Voice: a scout talking to the manager in a car park. Plain words, one real detail, no adjectives doing the work.
firstLook: Only seen him the once, so take this with a pinch of salt.
One game, from the far end. First impressions only.
Caught him on a wet Tuesday. Early days.

reflexes: Quick hands. Stopped two from six yards when I watched and made neither look hard.
Reacts before the striker's finished the swing. Point-blank stuff is his.
handling: Holds everything. You don't see the ball bounce off him into the six-yard box.
Catches what other keepers parry. Saves you a lot of second balls.
oneOnOnes: Stays big and stays up when a forward is through. Makes them pick the shot.
Good at the one-on-ones. Comes out quick and narrows the angle.
aerialCommand: Owns his box at corners. Shouts, comes, punches clear.
Takes crosses at the highest point. Defenders like playing in front of him.
passing: Kicks it to feet, both sides. Your full-backs will thank him.
Starts attacks. Rolls it out quick and picks the free man.
composure: Doesn't panic with the ball at his feet, even with a striker on him.
Same face at 0-0 and 0-2. Calm keeper.

tackling: Wins it clean. Times his tackles and doesn't need to go to ground.
Hard to get past one-on-one. Gets a foot in and comes away with it.
heading: Wins his headers, both boxes. Good for three or four goals from corners.
Attacks the ball in the air. Long balls into him come straight back.
strength: Strong. Forwards bounce off him and stop trying after half an hour.
Big, and uses it. Pins his man and doesn't get shoved off the ball.
positioning: Reads it early. He's usually standing where the pass is going.
Doesn't need to be quick because he's never in the wrong place.
pace: Quick for a centre-half. Will let you play a high line.
Can cover the space behind. Recovery pace gets him out of trouble.
passing: Passes it forward from the back, and through the lines when it's on.
Comfortable bringing it out and finding the midfield.
composure: Calm on the ball under a press. Won't hoof it when he doesn't need to.
Never flustered. Picks his moment to clear and his moment to play.

pace: Quick both ways. Overlaps and still gets back.
Real pace. Wingers don't get in behind him often.
crossing: Good delivery from wide, early or from the byline. Hits the near post when he wants to.
Crosses with his {foot} foot and finds a head, not the keeper.
tackling: Defends first. Wingers have a bad afternoon against him.
Gets tight and wins it. Doesn't dive in.
stamina: Up and down for ninety minutes. Still overlapping at the end.
Engine on him. Last man running at full-time.
positioning: Tucks in at the right time. Keeps the back four tidy.
Knows when to go and when to stay. Rarely caught upfield.
dribbling: Will carry it up the line himself and beat a man.
Takes people on from full-back. Useful when the winger's marked.
workRate: Works hard for the side. Tracks his man all the way back.
Never stops. Coaches will love him.

tackling: Wins the ball back in the middle and gives it simple.
Breaks it up. Plenty of tackles, not many fouls.
positioning: Sits in front of the back four and fills every gap.
Always in the passing lane. Picks off a lot without having to tackle.
passing: Gets it and moves it on. Sets the tempo from deep.
Switches play well. Finds the full-back on the far side.
workRate: Covers ground. Does the running for whoever plays beside him.
Doesn't stop working. Snaps at people all afternoon.
strength: Strong in the middle. Hard to knock off it.
Physical. Wins his duels and lets people know.
decisions: Makes good choices. Knows when to keep it and when to clear it.
Never forces it. Plays what's on.

passing: Moves it quickly and keeps it. Plays a forward pass when there is one.
Good range. Finds the winger forty yards away with his {foot} foot.
stamina: Box to box for ninety minutes. Still arriving late in the second half.
Runs all day. You won't need to take him off.
workRate: Puts a shift in, both ways. The kind the others play for.
Presses, covers, gets back. Never hides.
decisions: Plays the right pass far more often than not. Doesn't waste the ball.
Clever. Sees the next pass before he's got this one.
longShots: Will score you a few from outside the box with his {foot} foot.
Shoots from distance and hits the target.
firstTouch: Takes it in his stride under pressure. First touch sets him up.
Lovely first touch. Gets out of tight spots.
tackling: Wins it back for a midfielder who likes to get forward.
Gets stuck in. Not afraid of a challenge.

passing: Sees the pass between the lines and has the touch to play it.
Plays the last ball. Your strikers will get chances.
dribbling: Gets past people in tight areas. Draws two and finds the spare.
Beats his man and turns the defence.
firstTouch: Receives on the half-turn. Hard to press because he's already facing forward.
Takes it under pressure, between the lines, and keeps going.
decisions: Knows when to shoot, when to pass and when to keep it.
Clever footballer. Rarely gives it away cheaply.
longShots: Shoots from the edge of the box and scores a few.
Dangerous from twenty-five yards with his {foot} foot.
offTheBall: Finds space around the box. Arrives late and unmarked.
Drifts into the gaps. Defenders lose him.
composure: Calm in front of goal. Doesn't snatch at chances.
Doesn't rush it. Waits for the keeper to go first.

pace: Very quick. Give him space behind and he's gone.
Raw pace. Full-backs drop off him and give him room.
dribbling: Takes his man on every time and wins more than he loses.
Direct. Goes at defenders and gets fouled a lot.
crossing: Good delivery. Whips it in early with his {foot} foot.
Crosses for heads, not hopes. Picks out the run.
finishing: Comes inside and scores. Wants to shoot.
Finishes like a striker from wide. Gets you ten a season.
workRate: Tracks back. Your full-back won't be left alone.
Works for the team. Presses from the front and gets back.
firstTouch: Kills it dead on the touchline and is away.
Good first touch on the run. Doesn't need to slow down.

finishing: Scores. Doesn't need many chances and doesn't need a big backlift.
Hits the target. Finishes with either foot when he has to.
offTheBall: Gets away from his marker in the box. Always on the move.
Clever runs. Gets across the near post before the defender reacts.
heading: Good in the air. Crosses are worth putting in for him.
Wins headers in the box and scores a few with his head.
pace: Runs in behind. Defenders drop deep because of him.
Quick. Ball over the top and he's through.
strength: Holds it up. Back to goal, he keeps it till help arrives.
Strong. Bullies centre-halves and wins free kicks.
composure: Calm one-on-one. Takes the extra touch and slots it.
Doesn't panic in front of goal. Picks his spot.
firstTouch: Good first touch in the box. Sets himself and shoots.
Takes it down under pressure. Links play well.

reflexes: Slow to react to close-range shots, though.
handling: Spills a few, though. Have someone follow in.
oneOnOnes: Goes down too early when a striker's through, though.
aerialCommand: Stays on his line for crosses, though. Your centre-halves will have to deal with them.
passing: His passing lets him down. Gives it away when he tries to be clever.
Doesn't pass forward much. Plays it safe.
composure: Can get rattled. Watch him if the crowd gets on him.
Snatches at it when it matters.
tackling: Doesn't win many tackles, though. Don't ask him to defend.
Dives in. You'll see yellow cards.
heading: Not much in the air, though. Long balls will be a problem.
Avoids headers.
positioning: Wanders out of position. You'll need someone to cover.
Switches off and gets caught ball-watching.
pace: Not quick, though. Don't leave him one-on-one in space.
Lacks pace. A quick forward will give him a hard afternoon.
crossing: His crossing is poor, though. Most go behind or into the first man.
stamina: Fades after an hour. Plan to take him off.
Blows up in the second half.
dribbling: Won't beat a man, though. Needs the pass on.
workRate: Doesn't track back much. Somebody else will be doing his running.
Picks and chooses when to work.
decisions: Decision-making is off. Shoots when he should pass and the other way round.
Forces it. Tries the killer ball when the simple one is on.
firstTouch: First touch is heavy, though. Gives defenders a chance.
Touch lets him down under pressure.
finishing: Doesn't finish his chances, though. Misses more than he should.
offTheBall: Static without the ball. Needs it to feet.

Professional: Good lad. First in, last out.
No trouble off the pitch. Looks after himself.
Ambitious: Wants to play at the top. He'll want to know where you finish.
Hungry. Says he wants to win things.
Leader: Talks all game. Organises the others.
Captain material. People listen to him.
Temperamental: Has a temper. Booked for dissent twice when I watched.
Loyal: Loyal to his club. Won't push for a move.
Settled where he is. It'll take a good offer.
